pin_regs.reason: multi-family CDC leaf (core/host/ingest): the recipe-3 pin register is single-clock, so core-family pins are registered on ck_core and the host, ingest-family pins (u_rank__qm_cls, u_rank__qm_d, u_rank__qm_t_cr, u_rank__qm_v, host_upstream_quiet_host, host_upstream_quiet_ingest, u_rank__qm_crn, u_rank__qm_t_d, u_rank__qm_t_v) are excluded: their faces are the RTL credit channels of that family

reviewed_gray_fifo_extensions.why: SQK-INGEST 10-21: u_hx / u_ox payload storage in two reviewed dual-clock 1R1W SRAMs (write port on the writer family root, read port on the reader family root, per-pin Liberty roles); the 32 ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1 qm-bank macros stay single-root (ck_ingest); Gray publication/synchroniser proof unchanged (1-bit ot_link_afifo pointer FIFOs)
